decisions.question: Use the Factory preload daemon bridge over loopback CDP; keep the desktop sign-in token inside the renderer
decisions.chosen: Use the Factory preload daemon bridge over loopback CDP; keep the desktop sign-in token inside the renderer
decisions.reasoning: Factory uses a private parent-child IPC channel. The exposed electronAPI.daemon bridge reaches its existing daemon without another CLI or UI automation. User authorized restart and Factory-only C drive session/log writes.
